entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support separate navigation query and update mappings, including read-only navigations #39422
    Backlog
  • Support configuring a model-level filter on a navigation #39421
    Backlog
  • Reject member and method translations incompatible with the mapped store representation #39420
    12.0.0
  • Improve postprocessor extensibility #39419
    Backlog
  • Improve preprocessor extensibility #39418
    Backlog
  • Null compensation is repeated for a nullable subquery used as a value of an inline collection `Contains` #39413
  • EF Core 10: after `Update` throws an identity conflict, the conflicting instance stays tracked as `Detached` and `SaveChanges` throws "Unexpected entry.EntityState: Detached #39412
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39411

Closed

  • SqliteCommand falsely reports bound prefix-less parameters as unbound when another parameter is missing #39370
    12.0-preview1
  • Navigation expansion improvements phase 2 #23206
  • Query: Pay your (technical) debt on time #18923
  • Rebuild column when migrating from computed to non-computed #14075
  • Adding computed column with wrong property type is unfixable (DateTime to DateTime?) #36091
  • dependency hygiene for System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs #39416
  • Relational query translation fails when a nested `OwnsMany` collection is projected to a DTO and then re-projected to the same DTO shape #39415

PullRequests

Created

  • Add NOT NULL for persisted computed column if the column is not nullable #39417
    community-contribution
  • Visit each IN value once when compensating for nullable values #39414
    community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39409

Merged

  • Fix unbound parameter reporting for prefix-less and positional parameters #39371
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Introduce scoped DatabaseFacade.UseCommandTimeout #39403
    community-contribution
  • Make parameter collection projections that cannot be materialized untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • Use Path.Join for relative path composition in tools #39401
    community-contribution
  • Allow changing CLR type without SQL conversion #39397
    community-contribution
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations reached through an element s… #38960
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos datetime fixed width #39131
    community-contribution
  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution
